commit.message:
fix(post): a trailing Go home entry merges with the end-of-program home

A Go home last in the program (an entry, or the last op's own after-
action - both fold into its PARAM AfterOperation home) was written,
then the post's close wrote the same reference return again before M30.
Each built-in post that homes at program end now records where its trip
home ended (homedAt = linesWritten(), a new PRELUDE helper) and onClose
skips its own home when nothing was written after it. Fanuc, Haas,
Mazak, Siemens 840D and Fanuc Lathe; Heidenhain and Tormach refuse a
trip home by name, unchanged. Mid-program homes, Suppress and "Skip
pauses and homes" are untouched. Decision in
docs/decisions/504-trailing-home.md.

Fixes #504

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
